title: B-index polynomial for twisted knots
summary: A twisted link is a generalization of a virtual link associated with link diagrams on closed surfaces, which may be non-orientable. In this paper, we generalize the notion of the index value for twisted knots. Based on this generalization, we introduce a polynomial invariant for twisted knots, called the $\mathcal{B}$-Index polynomial. Furthermore, we construct a family of twisted knots $\{D_n\}_{n\geq 1}$ with arc shift number $n$ and determine their $\mathcal{B}$-Index polynomials explicitly in terms of $n$.
